## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting user-visible or maintenance outcome.

## Validation

List automated checks and relevant Obsidian application testing performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests under `tests/unit/` when behavior changed.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] I tested relevant commands, settings, hotkeys, editor behavior, or popout windows in Obsidian when applicable.
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation remain behaviorally consistent when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased` for a notable change.
- [ ] I did not change release versions unless the maintainer explicitly authorized a release.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI assistance and reviewed generated material according to `AI-ASSISTANCE.md`.
